subject: Human Evolution
title: Health Risks from Archaic DNA
description: One-minute skill: Health Risks from Archaic DNA.

hook.text: Neanderthal DNA isn't all helpful. Some inherited variants increase risk for depression and blood clotting.

buildup.text: Genes that helped in ice age Europe may misfire in modern environments with different diets and lifestyles.

discovery.text: Studies link Neanderthal variants to higher rates of type 2 diabetes, lupus, and nicotine addiction.

twist.text: These same variants may have been advantageous in their original context—coagulation helps seal wounds fast.

climax.text: Ancient adaptations can become modern liabilities when the environment changes faster than our genes.

punchline.text: Yesterday's survival hack is today's health risk.

quiz.question: Why can Neanderthal DNA cause health problems today?
options: Adaptations for ice age environments can misfire in modern ones
